description: Source code for a Jira importer module that reads Jira XML data, processes it into board and card structures, and exports a board archive. Contains functions for parsing XML, creating board and card objects, mapping properties, and generating output.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function to read input XML, parse it, convert to board and block structures, and write output archive.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts Jira items into boards and blocks, creating properties and mapping item fields.

methods.name: buildCardPropertyFromValues
methods.description: Creates a property template with options based on unique values from Jira items.

methods.name: setSelectProperty
methods.description: Sets a select-type property on a card based on a property value.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value on a card.

methods.name: optionForPropertyValue
methods.description: Finds the matching option for a property value.
